# plasma-nm editor headers

`vpnuiplugin.h`, `settingwidget.h` and `passwordfield.h` are copied unchanged from plasma-nm, tag in `VERSION`
(`libs/editor/` and `libs/editor/widgets/`), under `LGPL-2.1-only OR LGPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-LGPL`
(texts in `LICENSES/`; LGPL-3.0 builds on GPL-3.0, whose text is included too). plasma-nm ships no development
files; the editors link against its `libplasmanm_editor.so`. `plasmanm_editor_export.h` is ours (MIT).
